permission.summary: Asked by email to onlinesupport@filmhouseng.com from Chimezie on 11 Nov 2026. No reply yet.

sources.notes: Booking URL pattern: /movies/<film>/showtimes/<date>/<site>/select-tickets?showtime=<id>. robots.txt could not be read on 6 Nov. 11 Nov: robots.txt read at www.filmhouseng.com. Public pages are allowed, but /api/ and every /select-tickets page are disallowed, so we may link to a booking page but never fetch one. The home page HTML carries no showtimes (drawn by script); if the times come from /api/, they are off limits without permission. Contact addresses on the home page: onlinesupport@filmhouseng.com, sales@filmhouseng.com.
